channel.title: mint - news
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: Taylor Swift is taking a step back from performing, but there's good news for fans
item.description: A celebrity psychic has claimed Taylor Swift is taking an extended break from major touring following her wedding, while predicting her next tour is already planned. The claims remain speculative and are not based on any official announcement.

item.title: Mamdani's new NYC second home tax could hit over 31,000 luxury properties
item.description: The list, published on Friday by the New York City Finance Department, identifies properties that may be liable for the new non-primary residence property surcharge. However, officials said the list is preliminary, and many properties could be removed after owners file appeals.

item.title: Quote of the day by Chris Evans: ‘All you really have in life I think is just now...’
item.description: Chris Evans’ reflection on surrendering to the present offers a perspective on a career defined by major success, reinvention and a legacy that extends far beyond Captain America.

item.title: Prime Video India signs multi-year CJ ENM deal to bring more than 100 Korean shows to India
item.description: Prime Video India has signed a multi-year deal with CJ ENM to bring more than 100 Korean titles, including 26 new shows, to Indian audiences over two years.

item.title: Seattle shooting: 15-year-old suspect arrested; police hunt second suspect
item.description: Seattle Mayor Katie Wilson said the teenager is being held in juvenile detention on suspicion of firearms violations and first-degree assault. The suspect was scheduled to appear in court on Monday afternoon.

item.title: 'Our family is in agony': Savannah Guthrie's heartbreaking appeal as mother Nancy remains missing for over 6 months
item.description: In a video shared on Instagram on Monday (July 27), Savannah Guthrie addressed those she believes may have information about her mother's disappearance, urging them to come forward and help bring the case to a close.

item.title: Delhi Police says 2,873 people with criminal antecedents attended Jantar Mantar protests
item.description: Delhi Police says facial recognition technology identified 2,873 people with criminal antecedents at the NEET protest between July 20 and 25. Authorities are investigating their alleged role in violence at Jantar Mantar.

item.title: Trump warns of ‘very strong military action’ against Iran if diplomacy fails
item.description: Trump said diplomacy remained the preferred option but cautioned that the window for talks was limited.

item.title: Rahul Bhatia’s leadership revamp reaches the finance office; Thadimarri is new IndiGo CFO
item.description: Following a series of leadership transitions, IndiGo appointed Kiran Thadimarri as its new CFO. Gaurav Negi will serve as an adviser. These changes come amid plans for significant expansion and after the airline reported financial losses in the June quarter, leading to regulatory scrutiny.

item.title: Govt projects 26 GW of power demand from data centres by FY32
item.description: India's peak demand has reached 270.8GW. It is projected to reach 272GW this year and 300GW in the next fiscal.

item.title: CJP Protest: ‘Craziest naarebazi’ reunited lost child with mother during internet suspension at Jantar Mantar — Video
item.description: During the CJP protest at Delhi's Jantar Mantar, a spontaneous announcement helped reunite a lost child with his mother. Instagram user Abishai George's viral post highlighted the moment of humanity amidst the demonstration over the NEET-UG 2026 paper leak.

item.title: Deep depression intensifies over Bay of Bengal; orange alert for Delhi, Punjab, Maharashtra on July 28: IMD
item.description: The IMD said the weather system, along with an active monsoon trough, is expected to create favourable conditions for heavy rainfall across several states.

item.title: Bihar withdraws FIRs against NEET paper leak protesters, orders release of detainees
item.description: The Bihar government has announced it will withdraw all FIRs and legal notices against NEET paper leak protesters and release those arrested before July 26, following mounting political pressure.

item.title: Saudi Aramco Abqaiq oil facility fire: Riyadh blames drone attack
item.description: The image could not independently confirm the cause of the smoke or the extent of any damage at the facility.

item.title: Elon Musk takes ‘crusade’ for Armie Hammer film to Europe after controversial X promotion
item.description: Elon Musk has turned a controversial Armie Hammer film into an unlikely international talking point after using his social media platform X to promote it to millions of viewers.

item.title: Russia Mount Elbrus tragedy: Five Bosnian climbers die on Europe's highest peak; bad weather delays recovery of 3 bodies
item.description: The climbers were part of a seven-member expedition on Mount Elbrus, which rises 5,642 metres (18,510 feet) above sea level near Russia's border with Georgia.&nbsp;

item.title: NEET paper leak case: CBI counsel misses first hearing in fast-track court; matter adjourned to August 3
item.description: The judge directed the “director of prosecution to depute a public prosecutor in the present court”.

item.title: CJP launches legal aid fund website for NEET protesters, Kapil Sibal pledges ₹1 crore
item.description: Cockroach Janata Party on Monday flagged apprehensions of post-protest targeting of individuals and said it had set up a nationwide legal network to protect students, citing a ‘playbook’ used in previous agitations to implicate protestors in false cases.

item.title: Taco Bell customer visits tumble 31% after Cyclospora parasite outbreak tied to lettuce — Report
item.description: The decline came after health authorities connected a multistate Cyclospora outbreak to shredded iceberg lettuce supplied by Taylor Farms and served at Taco Bell and other restaurant chains.

item.title: Salman Khan gets relief as Delhi HC orders 'Kala Hiran' teaser be removed; observes ‘Reputation once lost is lost’
item.description: While hearing Salman Khan's application seeking an interim injunction to restrain the film's release, promotion and publicity, Justice Jyoti Singh also indicated that interviews of the film's producer, Amit Jani, would be directed to be removed from online platforms.

item.title: Need LPG refill fast? IndianOil launches 4-hour delivery service; check cities, features
item.description: Launched initially in Pune, Gurugram, Indore and Coimbatore, Indane XTRALITE Now reflects IndianOil's continued commitment to innovation and customer-centric energy solutions.

item.title: Business consultant loses ‘strong’ candidate after 4-month-long hunt — The reason will shock you
item.description: The business consultant was surprised when he said the issue was the “founder's memory and mood”.

item.title: Kharif sowing gap narrows, but acreage remains below year-ago level
item.description: Acreage of key kharif crops, including paddy, pulses, oilseeds and cotton, remained below last year's levels, although the overall sowing gap has narrowed in recent weeks as monsoon rainfall improved across several regions.

item.title: US weather forecast: Dangerous heat wave, severe thunderstorms and flash flood threat to hit multiple states
item.description: While a powerful heat dome continues to bake the central and southern US, multiple storm systems are forecast to bring damaging winds, hail and flooding from the Upper Midwest to the Northeast.

item.title: ‘Pandit ji’ lights diya inside AC train coach, performs puja: 'What if it catches fire? - Video
item.description: Many users said religious practices should not put other passengers at risk, particularly in shared public spaces such as trains.

item.title: Setback for Vijay-led TVK govt! Madras HC sets aside order on govt jobs to kin of Karur stampede victims
item.description: Delivering the verdict, a Division Bench of Justices CV Karthikeyan and R. Sakthivel said extending such appointments would be unfair to the large number of applicants who have been awaiting compassionate appointments in various government departments.

item.title: Christopher Nolan’s The Odyssey leaked on X, pirated copy gains more than 2 million views
item.description: Christopher Nolan’s The Odyssey has been hit by a major online piracy incident after a high-quality copy of the film was shared on X.

item.title: What are fire clouds or pyrocumulonimbus? How they formed over France's wildfires — Explained
item.description: National Firefighters Federation of France (FNSPF) said the giant wildfire in the country's southwest had generated a pyrocumulonimbus — a phenomenon they described as never before observed in France.

item.title: Delhi weather today: Rain lashes parts of capital city; IMD issues ‘yellow’ alert for thunderstorms
item.description: Light rain and light thunderstorms accompanied by lightning and gusty winds with speeds of 30-40 kmph are very likely, according to the IMD.

item.title: CJP to protest again? Ashutosh Ranka warns of sit-in if govt assurances not met immediately — ‘breach of agreement’
item.description: CJP spokesperson Ashutosh Ranka accused the central government of violating an agreement. He demanded the withdrawal of FIRs against protesters, release of detained students, and assurance of no future filings, warning protests will resume otherwise.

item.title: Why Demis Hassabis sold DeepMind to Google in 2014: Needed $7 billion but could 'barely raise $10 million'
item.description: Demis Hassabis, co-founder of DeepMind, revealed that the 2014 sale to Google was driven by financial necessity, citing a $7 billion need. DeepMind’s breakthrough in training AI agents led to its fame, despite being revenue-less.&nbsp;

item.title: ITR filings cross 40 million mark as 31 July deadline nears
item.description: The department's upgraded e-filing portal has also handled record traffic this filing season, processing more than one crore taxpayer interactions in a single day, with peak daily interactions touching 16 million.

item.title: Rhiya Yadav, viral face of Mumbai NEET protest, files FIR over online harassment: ‘As a woman, I want to….'
item.description: Mumbai NEET protest: Although many social media users lauded her actions and expressed support, Rhiya Yadav said she also became the target of abusive and harassing content online.

item.title: 26-year-old Indian-origin woman shot dead in Toronto in ‘targeted attack’; suspect arrested
item.description: Navneet Kaur, a 26-year-old woman of Indian origin, was fatally shot in a targeted attack in Toronto. A suspect, Sharanjit Singh, has been arrested and charged with first-degree murder.&nbsp;

item.title: Kangana Ranaut slams Gen Z CJP protestors for ‘puke inducing, crass’ language — ‘Ewwww’
item.description: Kangana Ranaut tore into the “cockroaches” and said, “You look/behave like them as well. There is no paradox or juxtaposition there.”
